carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal linear feature running along the lateral midline from the left frame edge to the caudal keel, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (dorsal) to low-intensity (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notches and jagged contours present on the distal trailing edge of the superior caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits approximately five faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs on its lateral surface.
